# AEOGEO Search

> AEOGEO Search is an AIO, GEO, AEO, and SEO agency in McKinney, Texas. Founder Michelle S. has 15 years’ experience in digital marketing.

Contact: https://aeogeosearch.com/contact · (469) 905-2836 · McKinney, Texas

## Services
Our pricing page is the source of truth: 12 service options in six categories, plus separate self-service GEO Audit plans. Published pricing includes the $149/month GEO Audit Professional plan, alongside managed AI Search Optimization plans at $349/$649/$999 per month and the $1,500 one-time Knowledge Base Package. Combination packages combine existing services and are not additional underlying options.
- [Monthly AI Search Optimization Plans](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#monthly-ai-search): Starter $349/month, Growth $649/month, Authority $999/month. Starter includes up to 2 existing website pages/month; Growth and Authority each include up to 4.
- [Workflow Automation Setup and Support](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#workflow-automation): Automation Quick Start, Connected Workflow Setup, and Automation Monitoring and Support.
- [Content Support Services](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#content-support): Website Content Optimization, New SEO and AI Ready Article, and Content and Social Media Plan.
- [Content Repurposing Service](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#content-repurposing): $400 and up, with agreed scope.
- [Custom Websites](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#custom-websites): Custom quote based on scope.
- [Knowledge Base Package](https://aeogeosearch.com/pricing#knowledge-base): $1,500 one time; 50 articles, basic search, one revision round and one hour of training.

## Free offer
- [Free AI Visibility Snapshot](https://aeogeosearch.com/visibility-tool): A self-reported website-readiness checklist with a readiness percentage based only on the visitor's four answers, not an automated scan, competitor comparison or measured AI visibility score.

Project cancellation is by email, with a full refund before work starts and generally no refund after work starts, subject to law.

## Free GEO website audit
- [Free 25-page GEO Website Audit](https://aeogeosearch.com/geo-audit/): One free audit per verified account, up to 25 accessible pages across 20 scored readiness checks (two additional dimensions are in development and unscored). Findings distinguish measured checks, heuristics and unavailable data. The customer or their developer implements the changes. No credit card required. The audit page lists the current paid DIY audit plans and billing options.
- [GEO Content Checker](https://aeogeosearch.com/tools/geo-content-checker/): Needs-only editorial checklist, not an outline or implementation guide. Optional content services remain separate.

## Individual guides
- [What is AI search optimization?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/what-is-ai-search-optimization/): A complete guide to how AI search works, plus the SEO, AEO, GEO, content, technical, local and measurement practices behind it.
- [What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/what-is-geo/): A definition of Generative Engine Optimization, the research behind it, and the content practices that earn citations in generative AI answers.
- [What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/what-is-aeo/): A complete guide to Answer Engine Optimization, covering how answer engines work, how to structure content for direct answers, and how to measure results.
- [What is the difference between SEO, AEO, GEO, and AIO?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/seo-aeo-geo-aio-difference/): How the four disciplines differ, what each one is responsible for, and how to combine them in one search strategy.
- [How are Google AI Overviews changing search in 2026?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/ai-overviews-changing-search/): How Google AI Overviews are changing search, including their reach, the queries they answer, and what the shift means for organic clicks.
- [Why are zero-click searches rising  -  and what can businesses do about it?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/zero-click-search/): Why most U.S. Google searches now end without a click, and how businesses can stay visible inside AI answers instead of relying on clicks.
- [How do you get cited in AI answers from Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and ChatGPT?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/get-cited-ai-answers/): Twelve GEO and AEO strategies for earning citations in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity, covering content, authority and measurement.
- [Which AI search platforms should your business optimize for in 2026?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/which-ai-platforms/): Which AI platforms to prioritize, how much traffic each one sends, and where to start when your audience is spread across ChatGPT, AI Overviews and Perplexity.
- [How do you measure AI search visibility and GEO performance?](https://aeogeosearch.com/resources/measure-ai-visibility/): How to test and track AI mentions, citations and share of voice across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Copilot, including local AI visibility, tools and reporting.
